mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 8 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 8, low 6.

Hackers are targeting supermarket refrigeration units across Europe, with about 13,000 fridge and freezer control systems compromised.

Pope Leon XIV, the first American-born pope, has already cast his ballot in the U.S. midterm elections by mailing his vote from Chicago.

Only four clubs remain unbeaten in the opening weeks of Europe's top five leagues: Lazio, Roma, Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund.

Vivienne, the 18-year-old daughter of Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie, has legally dropped the Pitt surname after a Los Angeles court approved her request.

Pediatric experts warn that even small amounts of aromatic incense and essential oils can cause severe poisoning if ingested by young children.
